description: A canned two-party support-call transcript carrying at least one instance of every PII class this substrate claims to redact, including ASR-specific spoken-digit and spoken-email forms. Every value below is synthetic: the card number and IBAN are published test values, the SSN and phone numbers are reserved/never-issued ranges, the addresses are fictional. Segment timings include silence gaps so HeuristicDiarizer has turn boundaries to find.

segments.text: Thanks for calling, could I take your name and a contact number please.
Sure, my mobile is 07700 900482 and you can also reach me on +44 20 7946 0958.
Great, and what email should I put on the account.
It's jane dot harper at example dot com, or the work one, j.harper@contoso.co.uk.
Perfect. Can you confirm your date of birth for security.
I was born on 14/03/1979, and my social security number is 123-45-6789.
Thank you. And the billing address we have on file.
That's 221B Baker Street, London, NW1 6XE, though post goes to PO Box 4471.
Now the card on the account ends in six seven, the full number is 4539 1488 0343 6467.
And the refund should go to the account at GB82 WEST 12345698765432 if that's easier.
One more thing, the reference the agent gave me was double four seven three one nine two eight.
My US number for the callback is (413) 555-0134, that's the best line.
Read the long one back to me, it's four one three five five five oh one three four.
All confirmed, we ship to 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue, Washington DC 20500.
Order forty two shipped, and the invoice reference is 4539148803436460.
